name.en: “Your nephew in Canada is in trouble, send money now”
name.hi: “कनाडा में आपका भतीजा मुसीबत में है, अभी पैसे भेजो”
name.ta: “கனடாவில் உங்கள் மருமகன் சிக்கலில் இருக்கிறான், இப்போதே பணம் அனுப்புங்கள்”
name.te: “కెనడాలో మీ మేనల్లుడు ఇబ్బందిలో ఉన్నాడు, ఇప్పుడే డబ్బు పంపండి”
name.ml: “കാനഡയിൽ നിങ്ങളുടെ മരുമകൻ കുഴപ്പത്തിലാണ്, ഇപ്പോൾത്തന്നെ പണം അയയ്ക്കൂ”
name.kn: “ಕೆನಡಾದಲ್ಲಿ ನಿಮ್ಮ ಸೋದರಳಿಯ ತೊಂದರೆಯಲ್ಲಿದ್ದಾನೆ, ಈಗಲೇ ಹಣ ಕಳುಹಿಸಿ”

they_say.en: A WhatsApp call from a foreign number: “Your nephew had a fight here. He will be deported unless we pay the fine today. Don’t tell his parents.” A crying “relative” comes on the line.
they_say.hi: विदेशी नंबर से WhatsApp कॉल: “आपके भतीजे का यहां झगड़ा हो गया है। आज जुर्माना नहीं भरा तो उसे देश से निकाल देंगे। उसके माता-पिता को मत बताना।” लाइन पर रोता हुआ एक “रिश्तेदार” आता है।
they_say.ta: வெளிநாட்டு எண்ணிலிருந்து வாட்ஸ்அப் அழைப்பு: “உங்கள் மருமகன் இங்கே சண்டையில் சிக்கிவிட்டான். இன்றே அபராதம் கட்டாவிட்டால் நாடு கடத்தப்படுவான். அவன் பெற்றோரிடம் சொல்லாதீர்கள்.” அழுதுகொண்டே ஒரு “உறவினர்” லைனில் வருகிறார்.
they_say.te: విదేశీ నంబర్ నుంచి వాట్సాప్ కాల్: “మీ మేనల్లుడు ఇక్కడ గొడవలో ఇరుక్కున్నాడు. ఈరోజే జరిమానా కట్టకపోతే దేశం నుంచి పంపేస్తారు. వాడి తల్లిదండ్రులకు చెప్పకండి.” ఏడుస్తూ ఒక “బంధువు” లైన్‌లోకి వస్తారు.
they_say.ml: വിദേശ നമ്പറിൽ നിന്ന് വാട്സ്ആപ്പ് കോൾ: “നിങ്ങളുടെ മരുമകൻ ഇവിടെ ഒരു വഴക്കിൽ പെട്ടു. ഇന്ന് പിഴ അടച്ചില്ലെങ്കിൽ നാടുകടത്തും. അവന്റെ മാതാപിതാക്കളോട് പറയരുത്.” കരയുന്ന ഒരു “ബന്ധു” ലൈനിൽ വരും.
they_say.kn: ವಿದೇಶಿ ನಂಬರ್‌ನಿಂದ ವಾಟ್ಸ್‌ಆ್ಯಪ್ ಕರೆ: “ನಿಮ್ಮ ಸೋದರಳಿಯ ಇಲ್ಲಿ ಜಗಳದಲ್ಲಿ ಸಿಕ್ಕಿಬಿದ್ದಿದ್ದಾನೆ. ಇಂದೇ ದಂಡ ಕಟ್ಟದಿದ್ದರೆ ಗಡಿಪಾರು ಮಾಡುತ್ತಾರೆ. ಅವನ ತಂದೆ-ತಾಯಿಗೆ ಹೇಳಬೇಡಿ.” ಅಳುತ್ತಿರುವ ಒಬ್ಬ “ಸಂಬಂಧಿಕ” ಲೈನ್‌ಗೆ ಬರುತ್ತಾರೆ.

they_ask.en: Send money urgently to an account or UPI ID.
they_ask.hi: किसी खाते या UPI ID पर तुरंत पैसे भेजें।
they_ask.ta: ஒரு கணக்குக்கோ UPI ID-க்கோ அவசரமாகப் பணம் அனுப்புங்கள்.
they_ask.te: ఒక ఖాతాకు లేదా UPI IDకి అర్జెంట్‌గా డబ్బు పంపండి.
they_ask.ml: ഒരു അക്കൗണ്ടിലേക്കോ UPI ID-യിലേക്കോ അടിയന്തരമായി പണം അയയ്ക്കുക.
they_ask.kn: ಒಂದು ಖಾತೆ ಅಥವಾ UPI IDಗೆ ತುರ್ತಾಗಿ ಹಣ ಕಳುಹಿಸಿ.

red_flag.en: Urgency, secrecy and a voice you can’t quite check. Scammers pick families with children studying abroad.
red_flag.hi: जल्दबाजी, राज रखने को कहना, और ऐसी आवाज जिसे आप ठीक से पहचान न सकें। ठग उन परिवारों को चुनते हैं जिनके बच्चे विदेश में पढ़ते हैं।
red_flag.ta: அவசரம், ரகசியம், சரியாக உறுதிசெய்ய முடியாத குரல். வெளிநாட்டில் பிள்ளைகள் படிக்கும் குடும்பங்களை மோசடியாளர்கள் குறிவைக்கிறார்கள்.
red_flag.te: తొందర, రహస్యం, సరిగ్గా నిర్ధారించలేని గొంతు. పిల్లలు విదేశాల్లో చదువుతున్న కుటుంబాలను మోసగాళ్లు ఎంచుకుంటారు.
red_flag.ml: തിടുക്കം, രഹസ്യം, ശരിക്കും ഉറപ്പിക്കാനാകാത്ത ശബ്ദം. മക്കൾ വിദേശത്ത് പഠിക്കുന്ന കുടുംബങ്ങളെയാണ് തട്ടിപ്പുകാർ ലക്ഷ്യമിടുന്നത്.
red_flag.kn: ಅವಸರ, ಗುಟ್ಟು, ಸರಿಯಾಗಿ ಖಚಿತಪಡಿಸಲಾಗದ ಧ್ವನಿ. ಮಕ್ಕಳು ವಿದೇಶದಲ್ಲಿ ಓದುತ್ತಿರುವ ಕುಟುಂಬಗಳನ್ನು ವಂಚಕರು ಗುರಿ ಮಾಡುತ್ತಾರೆ.

do.en: Before you pay, call them or their family on a number you already have.
do.hi: पैसे भेजने से पहले उन्हें या उनके परिवार को उस नंबर पर कॉल करें जो आपके पास पहले से है।
do.ta: பணம் அனுப்பும் முன், உங்களிடம் ஏற்கனவே உள்ள எண்ணில் அவர்களையோ அவர்கள் குடும்பத்தையோ அழையுங்கள்.
do.te: డబ్బు పంపే ముందు, మీ దగ్గర ఇప్పటికే ఉన్న నంబర్‌కు వారికి గానీ వారి కుటుంబానికి గానీ కాల్ చేయండి.
do.ml: പണം അയയ്ക്കും മുമ്പ്, നിങ്ങളുടെ കൈയിൽ നേരത്തേയുള്ള നമ്പറിൽ അവരെയോ അവരുടെ കുടുംബത്തെയോ വിളിക്കൂ.
do.kn: ಹಣ ಕಳುಹಿಸುವ ಮೊದಲು, ನಿಮ್ಮ ಬಳಿ ಈಗಾಗಲೇ ಇರುವ ನಂಬರ್‌ಗೆ ಅವರಿಗೆ ಅಥವಾ ಅವರ ಕುಟುಂಬಕ್ಕೆ ಕರೆ ಮಾಡಿ.

sources.name: RBI: BE(A)WARE booklet on frauds and precautions (2022)
The Tribune (Haryana Police advisory)

name.en: “Install this app so I can fix it” (screen sharing)
name.hi: “यह ऐप इंस्टॉल करें, मैं ठीक कर दूंगा” (स्क्रीन शेयरिंग)
name.ta: “இந்தச் செயலியை இன்ஸ்டால் செய்யுங்கள், நான் சரிசெய்கிறேன்” (திரைப் பகிர்வு)
name.te: “ఈ యాప్ ఇన్‌స్టాల్ చేయండి, నేను సరిచేస్తాను” (స్క్రీన్ షేరింగ్)
name.ml: “ഈ ആപ്പ് ഇൻസ്റ്റാൾ ചെയ്യൂ, ഞാൻ ശരിയാക്കാം” (സ്ക്രീൻ ഷെയറിങ്)
name.kn: “ಈ ಆ್ಯಪ್ ಇನ್‌ಸ್ಟಾಲ್ ಮಾಡಿ, ನಾನು ಸರಿಪಡಿಸುತ್ತೇನೆ” (ಸ್ಕ್ರೀನ್ ಶೇರಿಂಗ್)

they_say.en: I’m from your bank’s support team. Install AnyDesk or this app and read me the code, and I’ll fix your problem.
they_say.hi: मैं आपके बैंक की सपोर्ट टीम से हूं। AnyDesk या यह ऐप इंस्टॉल करके मुझे कोड बताइए, मैं आपकी दिक्कत ठीक कर दूंगा।
they_say.ta: நான் உங்கள் வங்கியின் உதவிக் குழுவிலிருந்து பேசுகிறேன். AnyDesk அல்லது இந்தச் செயலியை இன்ஸ்டால் செய்து குறியீட்டைச் சொல்லுங்கள், உங்கள் பிரச்சினையைச் சரிசெய்கிறேன்.
they_say.te: నేను మీ బ్యాంకు సపోర్ట్ టీమ్ నుంచి. AnyDesk లేదా ఈ యాప్ ఇన్‌స్టాల్ చేసి కోడ్ చెప్పండి, మీ సమస్య సరిచేస్తాను.
they_say.ml: ഞാൻ നിങ്ങളുടെ ബാങ്കിന്റെ സപ്പോർട്ട് ടീമിൽ നിന്നാണ്. AnyDesk അല്ലെങ്കിൽ ഈ ആപ്പ് ഇൻസ്റ്റാൾ ചെയ്ത് കോഡ് പറയൂ, ഞാൻ പ്രശ്നം ശരിയാക്കാം.
they_say.kn: ನಾನು ನಿಮ್ಮ ಬ್ಯಾಂಕ್‌ನ ಸಹಾಯ ತಂಡದಿಂದ. AnyDesk ಅಥವಾ ಈ ಆ್ಯಪ್ ಇನ್‌ಸ್ಟಾಲ್ ಮಾಡಿ ಕೋಡ್ ಹೇಳಿ, ನಿಮ್ಮ ಸಮಸ್ಯೆ ಸರಿಪಡಿಸುತ್ತೇನೆ.

they_ask.en: To install a screen-sharing app and share its code.
they_ask.hi: स्क्रीन शेयर करने वाला ऐप इंस्टॉल करें और उसका कोड बताएं।
they_ask.ta: திரையைப் பகிரும் செயலியை இன்ஸ்டால் செய்து அதன் குறியீட்டைச் சொல்லுங்கள்.
they_ask.te: స్క్రీన్ షేరింగ్ యాప్ ఇన్‌స్టాల్ చేసి దాని కోడ్ చెప్పండి.
they_ask.ml: സ്ക്രീൻ ഷെയറിങ് ആപ്പ് ഇൻസ്റ്റാൾ ചെയ്ത് അതിന്റെ കോഡ് പറയുക.
they_ask.kn: ಸ್ಕ್ರೀನ್ ಶೇರಿಂಗ್ ಆ್ಯಪ್ ಇನ್‌ಸ್ಟಾಲ್ ಮಾಡಿ ಅದರ ಕೋಡ್ ಹೇಳಿ.

red_flag.en: A stranger wants to see or control your phone’s screen.
red_flag.hi: कोई अनजान व्यक्ति आपके फोन की स्क्रीन देखना या चलाना चाहता है।
red_flag.ta: ஒரு தெரியாதவர் உங்கள் போன் திரையைப் பார்க்கவோ இயக்கவோ விரும்புகிறார்.
red_flag.te: ఒక అపరిచితుడు మీ ఫోన్ స్క్రీన్‌ను చూడాలని లేదా నడపాలని అనుకుంటున్నాడు.
red_flag.ml: ഒരു അപരിചിതൻ നിങ്ങളുടെ ഫോൺ സ്ക്രീൻ കാണാനോ നിയന്ത്രിക്കാനോ ആഗ്രഹിക്കുന്നു.
red_flag.kn: ಒಬ್ಬ ಅಪರಿಚಿತರು ನಿಮ್ಮ ಫೋನ್ ಸ್ಕ್ರೀನ್ ನೋಡಲು ಅಥವಾ ನಿಯಂತ್ರಿಸಲು ಬಯಸುತ್ತಾರೆ.

do.en: Never install a screen-sharing app because a caller asks, and never share its code. Install one only when the company’s official toll-free number tells you to, and remove it afterwards.
do.hi: किसी कॉल करने वाले के कहने पर स्क्रीन शेयर करने वाला ऐप कभी इंस्टॉल न करें, न उसका कोड बताएं। ऐसा ऐप तभी लगाएं जब कंपनी के ऑफिशियल टोल-फ्री नंबर से कहा जाए, और काम के बाद हटा दें।
do.ta: அழைப்பவர் கேட்டார் என்பதற்காகத் திரையைப் பகிரும் செயலியை ஒருபோதும் இன்ஸ்டால் செய்யாதீர்கள், அதன் குறியீட்டைச் சொல்லாதீர்கள். நிறுவனத்தின் அதிகாரப்பூர்வ கட்டணமில்லா எண் சொன்னால் மட்டும் இன்ஸ்டால் செய்து, பிறகு நீக்கிவிடுங்கள்.
do.te: కాల్ చేసినవారు అడిగారని స్క్రీన్ షేరింగ్ యాప్‌ను ఎప్పుడూ ఇన్‌స్టాల్ చేయకండి, దాని కోడ్ చెప్పకండి. కంపెనీ అధికారిక టోల్-ఫ్రీ నంబర్ చెప్పినప్పుడే ఇన్‌స్టాల్ చేసి, తర్వాత తీసేయండి.
do.ml: വിളിക്കുന്നയാൾ ആവശ്യപ്പെട്ടതുകൊണ്ട് സ്ക്രീൻ ഷെയറിങ് ആപ്പ് ഒരിക്കലും ഇൻസ്റ്റാൾ ചെയ്യരുത്, അതിന്റെ കോഡ് പറയരുത്. കമ്പനിയുടെ ഔദ്യോഗിക ടോൾ-ഫ്രീ നമ്പർ പറയുമ്പോൾ മാത്രം ഇൻസ്റ്റാൾ ചെയ്ത്, പിന്നീട് നീക്കം ചെയ്യൂ.
do.kn: ಕರೆ ಮಾಡಿದವರು ಕೇಳಿದರು ಎಂದು ಸ್ಕ್ರೀನ್ ಶೇರಿಂಗ್ ಆ್ಯಪ್ ಎಂದಿಗೂ ಇನ್‌ಸ್ಟಾಲ್ ಮಾಡಬೇಡಿ, ಅದರ ಕೋಡ್ ಹೇಳಬೇಡಿ. ಕಂಪನಿಯ ಅಧಿಕೃತ ಟೋಲ್-ಫ್ರೀ ನಂಬರ್ ಹೇಳಿದಾಗ ಮಾತ್ರ ಇನ್‌ಸ್ಟಾಲ್ ಮಾಡಿ, ನಂತರ ತೆಗೆದುಹಾಕಿ.

sources.name: RBI: BE(A)WARE booklet on frauds and precautions (2022)
RBI: Raju and the Forty Thieves, 40 frauds and precautions (2022)

name.en: A friend’s new profile or email asks for money
name.hi: दोस्त की नई प्रोफाइल या ईमेल से पैसे की मांग
name.ta: நண்பரின் புதிய புரொஃபைல் அல்லது மின்னஞ்சல் பணம் கேட்கிறது
name.te: స్నేహితుడి కొత్త ప్రొఫైల్ లేదా ఈమెయిల్ డబ్బు అడుగుతోంది
name.ml: സുഹൃത്തിന്റെ പുതിയ പ്രൊഫൈലോ ഇമെയിലോ പണം ചോദിക്കുന്നു
name.kn: ಸ್ನೇಹಿತರ ಹೊಸ ಪ್ರೊಫೈಲ್ ಅಥವಾ ಇಮೇಲ್ ಹಣ ಕೇಳುತ್ತದೆ

they_say.en: It’s me. I’m in hospital, please send ₹10,000 to this account, I’ll return it tomorrow.
they_say.hi: मैं ही हूं। अस्पताल में हूं, प्लीज इस खाते में ₹10,000 भेज दो, कल लौटा दूंगा।
they_say.ta: நான்தான். மருத்துவமனையில் இருக்கிறேன், இந்தக் கணக்குக்கு ₹10,000 அனுப்புங்கள், நாளை திருப்பித் தருகிறேன்.
they_say.te: నేనే. ఆసుపత్రిలో ఉన్నాను, దయచేసి ఈ ఖాతాకు ₹10,000 పంపు, రేపు ఇచ్చేస్తాను.
they_say.ml: ഇത് ഞാനാണ്. ആശുപത്രിയിലാണ്, ഈ അക്കൗണ്ടിലേക്ക് ₹10,000 അയയ്ക്കൂ, നാളെ തിരിച്ചുതരാം.
they_say.kn: ನಾನೇ. ಆಸ್ಪತ್ರೆಯಲ್ಲಿದ್ದೇನೆ, ದಯವಿಟ್ಟು ಈ ಖಾತೆಗೆ ₹10,000 ಕಳುಹಿಸಿ, ನಾಳೆ ಹಿಂತಿರುಗಿಸುತ್ತೇನೆ.

they_ask.en: Money to a new account or UPI ID.
they_ask.hi: किसी नए खाते या UPI ID पर पैसे।
they_ask.ta: புதிய கணக்குக்கோ UPI ID-க்கோ பணம்.
they_ask.te: కొత్త ఖాతాకు లేదా UPI IDకి డబ్బు.
they_ask.ml: പുതിയ അക്കൗണ്ടിലേക്കോ UPI ID-യിലേക്കോ പണം.
they_ask.kn: ಹೊಸ ಖಾತೆ ಅಥವಾ UPI IDಗೆ ಹಣ.

red_flag.en: A new profile or email of someone you know, an emergency, and an account you haven’t seen before.
red_flag.hi: किसी जान-पहचान वाले की नई प्रोफाइल या ईमेल, कोई इमरजेंसी, और ऐसा खाता जो आपने पहले नहीं देखा।
red_flag.ta: தெரிந்தவரின் புதிய புரொஃபைல் அல்லது மின்னஞ்சல், ஒரு அவசரம், நீங்கள் இதுவரை பார்க்காத கணக்கு.
red_flag.te: తెలిసినవారి కొత్త ప్రొఫైల్ లేదా ఈమెయిల్, ఒక అత్యవసరం, మీరు ఇంతకుముందు చూడని ఖాతా.
red_flag.ml: പരിചയക്കാരന്റെ പുതിയ പ്രൊഫൈലോ ഇമെയിലോ, ഒരു അടിയന്തരാവസ്ഥ, നിങ്ങൾ മുമ്പ് കണ്ടിട്ടില്ലാത്ത അക്കൗണ്ട്.
red_flag.kn: ಪರಿಚಿತರ ಹೊಸ ಪ್ರೊಫೈಲ್ ಅಥವಾ ಇಮೇಲ್, ಒಂದು ತುರ್ತು, ನೀವು ಹಿಂದೆ ನೋಡದ ಖಾತೆ.

do.en: Before you pay, call or meet the person on the number you already have. Don’t accept friend requests from people you have never met.
do.hi: पैसे भेजने से पहले उस व्यक्ति को उस नंबर पर कॉल करें जो आपके पास पहले से है, या उनसे मिलें। जिनसे कभी नहीं मिले, उनकी फ्रेंड रिक्वेस्ट स्वीकार न करें।
do.ta: பணம் அனுப்பும் முன், உங்களிடம் ஏற்கனவே உள்ள எண்ணில் அவரை அழையுங்கள் அல்லது நேரில் சந்தியுங்கள். நீங்கள் சந்திக்காதவர்களின் நட்புக் கோரிக்கைகளை ஏற்காதீர்கள்.
do.te: డబ్బు పంపే ముందు, మీ దగ్గర ఇప్పటికే ఉన్న నంబర్‌కు ఆ వ్యక్తికి కాల్ చేయండి లేదా నేరుగా కలవండి. మీరు ఎప్పుడూ కలవనివారి ఫ్రెండ్ రిక్వెస్ట్‌లు ఒప్పుకోకండి.
do.ml: പണം അയയ്ക്കും മുമ്പ്, നിങ്ങളുടെ കൈയിൽ നേരത്തേയുള്ള നമ്പറിൽ ആ വ്യക്തിയെ വിളിക്കൂ, അല്ലെങ്കിൽ നേരിൽ കാണൂ. ഒരിക്കലും കണ്ടിട്ടില്ലാത്തവരുടെ ഫ്രണ്ട് റിക്വസ്റ്റുകൾ സ്വീകരിക്കരുത്.
do.kn: ಹಣ ಕಳುಹಿಸುವ ಮೊದಲು, ನಿಮ್ಮ ಬಳಿ ಈಗಾಗಲೇ ಇರುವ ನಂಬರ್‌ಗೆ ಆ ವ್ಯಕ್ತಿಗೆ ಕರೆ ಮಾಡಿ ಅಥವಾ ನೇರವಾಗಿ ಭೇಟಿಯಾಗಿ. ನೀವು ಎಂದಿಗೂ ಭೇಟಿಯಾಗದವರ ಫ್ರೆಂಡ್ ರಿಕ್ವೆಸ್ಟ್ ಒಪ್ಪಬೇಡಿ.

sources.name: RBI: BE(A)WARE booklet on frauds and precautions (2022)
RBI: Raju and the Forty Thieves, 40 frauds and precautions (2022)

name.en: Credit card call: fee waiver, activation or higher limit
name.hi: क्रेडिट कार्ड कॉल: फीस माफ, एक्टिवेशन या ज्यादा लिमिट
name.ta: கிரெடிட் கார்டு அழைப்பு: கட்டண விலக்கு, ஆக்டிவேஷன் அல்லது அதிக லிமிட்
name.te: క్రెడిట్ కార్డు కాల్: ఫీజు మాఫీ, యాక్టివేషన్ లేదా ఎక్కువ లిమిట్
name.ml: ക്രെഡിറ്റ് കാർഡ് കോൾ: ഫീസ് ഇളവ്, ആക്ടിവേഷൻ അല്ലെങ്കിൽ കൂടിയ ലിമിറ്റ്
name.kn: ಕ್ರೆಡಿಟ್ ಕಾರ್ಡ್ ಕರೆ: ಶುಲ್ಕ ಮನ್ನಾ, ಆ್ಯಕ್ಟಿವೇಶನ್ ಅಥವಾ ಹೆಚ್ಚು ಲಿಮಿಟ್

they_say.en: Your card’s annual fee can be waived, or your limit raised, or your new card needs activation. Just tell me the OTP.
they_say.hi: आपके कार्ड की सालाना फीस माफ हो सकती है, या लिमिट बढ़ सकती है, या आपका नया कार्ड एक्टिवेट करना है। बस मुझे OTP बता दीजिए।
they_say.ta: உங்கள் கார்டின் ஆண்டுக் கட்டணத்தைத் தள்ளுபடி செய்யலாம், அல்லது லிமிட்டை உயர்த்தலாம், அல்லது புதிய கார்டை ஆக்டிவேட் செய்ய வேண்டும். ஓடிபியை மட்டும் சொல்லுங்கள்.
they_say.te: మీ కార్డు వార్షిక ఫీజు మాఫీ చేయవచ్చు, లేదా లిమిట్ పెంచవచ్చు, లేదా కొత్త కార్డు యాక్టివేట్ చేయాలి. ఓటీపీ చెబితే చాలు.
they_say.ml: നിങ്ങളുടെ കാർഡിന്റെ വാർഷിക ഫീസ് ഒഴിവാക്കാം, അല്ലെങ്കിൽ ലിമിറ്റ് കൂട്ടാം, അല്ലെങ്കിൽ പുതിയ കാർഡ് ആക്ടിവേറ്റ് ചെയ്യണം. ഒടിപി മാത്രം പറഞ്ഞാൽ മതി.
they_say.kn: ನಿಮ್ಮ ಕಾರ್ಡ್‌ನ ವಾರ್ಷಿಕ ಶುಲ್ಕ ಮನ್ನಾ ಮಾಡಬಹುದು, ಅಥವಾ ಲಿಮಿಟ್ ಹೆಚ್ಚಿಸಬಹುದು, ಅಥವಾ ಹೊಸ ಕಾರ್ಡ್ ಆ್ಯಕ್ಟಿವೇಟ್ ಮಾಡಬೇಕು. ಒಟಿಪಿ ಹೇಳಿದರೆ ಸಾಕು.

they_ask.en: Your card details and the OTP.
they_ask.hi: आपके कार्ड की जानकारी और OTP।
they_ask.ta: உங்கள் கார்டு விவரங்களும் ஓடிபியும்.
they_ask.te: మీ కార్డు వివరాలు, ఓటీపీ.
they_ask.ml: നിങ്ങളുടെ കാർഡ് വിവരങ്ങളും ഒടിപിയും.
they_ask.kn: ನಿಮ್ಮ ಕಾರ್ಡ್ ವಿವರ ಮತ್ತು ಒಟಿಪಿ.

red_flag.en: A caller asking for your card number, CVV or OTP.
red_flag.hi: कोई कॉल करने वाला आपका कार्ड नंबर, CVV या OTP मांगे।
red_flag.ta: அழைப்பவர் உங்கள் கார்டு எண், CVV அல்லது ஓடிபியைக் கேட்கிறார்.
red_flag.te: కాల్ చేసినవారు మీ కార్డు నంబర్, CVV లేదా ఓటీపీ అడుగుతున్నారు.
red_flag.ml: വിളിക്കുന്നയാൾ നിങ്ങളുടെ കാർഡ് നമ്പറോ CVV-യോ ഒടിപിയോ ചോദിക്കുന്നു.
red_flag.kn: ಕರೆ ಮಾಡಿದವರು ನಿಮ್ಮ ಕಾರ್ಡ್ ನಂಬರ್, CVV ಅಥವಾ ಒಟಿಪಿ ಕೇಳುತ್ತಾರೆ.

do.en: Banks never ask for your OTP or card details on a call. Hang up and call the number on the back of your card. If you shared anything, block your card at once.
do.hi: बैंक कभी कॉल पर आपका OTP या कार्ड की जानकारी नहीं मांगते। फोन काट दें और अपने कार्ड के पीछे लिखे नंबर पर कॉल करें। अगर कुछ बता दिया है, तो तुरंत कार्ड ब्लॉक करवाएं।
do.ta: வங்கிகள் அழைப்பில் உங்கள் ஓடிபியையோ கார்டு விவரங்களையோ கேட்பதில்லை. இணைப்பைத் துண்டித்துவிட்டு உங்கள் கார்டின் பின்புறம் உள்ள எண்ணை அழையுங்கள். ஏதாவது சொல்லியிருந்தால், உடனே கார்டை முடக்குங்கள்.
do.te: బ్యాంకులు కాల్‌లో మీ ఓటీపీ గానీ కార్డు వివరాలు గానీ ఎప్పుడూ అడగవు. కాల్ కట్ చేసి మీ కార్డు వెనక ఉన్న నంబర్‌కు కాల్ చేయండి. ఏదైనా చెప్పేసి ఉంటే, వెంటనే కార్డు బ్లాక్ చేయించండి.
do.ml: ബാങ്കുകൾ കോളിൽ നിങ്ങളുടെ ഒടിപിയോ കാർഡ് വിവരങ്ങളോ ഒരിക്കലും ചോദിക്കില്ല. ഫോൺ കട്ട് ചെയ്ത് കാർഡിന്റെ പിന്നിലുള്ള നമ്പറിൽ വിളിക്കൂ. എന്തെങ്കിലും പറഞ്ഞുപോയെങ്കിൽ, ഉടൻ കാർഡ് ബ്ലോക്ക് ചെയ്യൂ.
do.kn: ಬ್ಯಾಂಕ್‌ಗಳು ಕರೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ನಿಮ್ಮ ಒಟಿಪಿ ಅಥವಾ ಕಾರ್ಡ್ ವಿವರ ಎಂದಿಗೂ ಕೇಳುವುದಿಲ್ಲ. ಕರೆ ಕಟ್ ಮಾಡಿ, ನಿಮ್ಮ ಕಾರ್ಡ್‌ನ ಹಿಂಭಾಗದಲ್ಲಿರುವ ನಂಬರ್‌ಗೆ ಕರೆ ಮಾಡಿ. ಏನಾದರೂ ಹೇಳಿಬಿಟ್ಟಿದ್ದರೆ, ತಕ್ಷಣ ಕಾರ್ಡ್ ಬ್ಲಾಕ್ ಮಾಡಿಸಿ.

sources.name: RBI: Raju and the Forty Thieves, 40 frauds and precautions (2022)
RBI: BE(A)WARE booklet on frauds and precautions (2022)

name.en: A “bank agent” collects your documents or a cheque
name.hi: “बैंक एजेंट” आपके कागज या चेक ले जाता है
name.ta: ஒரு “வங்கி ஏஜென்ட்” உங்கள் ஆவணங்களையோ காசோலையையோ வாங்குகிறார்
name.te: “బ్యాంకు ఏజెంట్” మీ పత్రాలు లేదా చెక్ తీసుకెళ్తాడు
name.ml: ഒരു “ബാങ്ക് ഏജന്റ്” നിങ്ങളുടെ രേഖകളോ ചെക്കോ വാങ്ങുന്നു
name.kn: ಒಬ್ಬ “ಬ್ಯಾಂಕ್ ಏಜೆಂಟ್” ನಿಮ್ಮ ದಾಖಲೆ ಅಥವಾ ಚೆಕ್ ತೆಗೆದುಕೊಳ್ಳುತ್ತಾರೆ

they_say.en: I’m from the bank. Give me copies of your Aadhaar and PAN and a signed cheque for your loan or FD overdraft.
they_say.hi: मैं बैंक से हूं। आपके लोन या FD ओवरड्राफ्ट के लिए आधार और PAN की कॉपी और एक साइन किया हुआ चेक दे दीजिए।
they_say.ta: நான் வங்கியிலிருந்து வருகிறேன். உங்கள் கடன் அல்லது FD ஓவர்டிராஃப்டுக்கு ஆதார், PAN நகல்களும் கையெழுத்திட்ட ஒரு காசோலையும் கொடுங்கள்.
they_say.te: నేను బ్యాంకు నుంచి. మీ లోన్ లేదా FD ఓవర్‌డ్రాఫ్ట్ కోసం ఆధార్, PAN కాపీలు, సంతకం చేసిన ఒక చెక్ ఇవ్వండి.
they_say.ml: ഞാൻ ബാങ്കിൽ നിന്നാണ്. നിങ്ങളുടെ ലോണിനോ FD ഓവർഡ്രാഫ്റ്റിനോ ആധാർ, PAN പകർപ്പുകളും ഒപ്പിട്ട ഒരു ചെക്കും തരൂ.
they_say.kn: ನಾನು ಬ್ಯಾಂಕ್‌ನಿಂದ ಬಂದಿದ್ದೇನೆ. ನಿಮ್ಮ ಸಾಲ ಅಥವಾ FD ಓವರ್‌ಡ್ರಾಫ್ಟ್‌ಗಾಗಿ ಆಧಾರ್, PAN ನಕಲು ಮತ್ತು ಸಹಿ ಮಾಡಿದ ಒಂದು ಚೆಕ್ ಕೊಡಿ.

they_ask.en: ID copies, signed forms or cheques.
they_ask.hi: पहचान पत्रों की कॉपी, साइन किए फॉर्म या चेक।
they_ask.ta: அடையாள அட்டை நகல்கள், கையெழுத்திட்ட படிவங்கள் அல்லது காசோலைகள்.
they_ask.te: గుర్తింపు కాపీలు, సంతకం చేసిన ఫారాలు లేదా చెక్కులు.
they_ask.ml: ID പകർപ്പുകൾ, ഒപ്പിട്ട ഫോമുകൾ അല്ലെങ്കിൽ ചെക്കുകൾ.
they_ask.kn: ಗುರುತಿನ ಚೀಟಿಯ ನಕಲು, ಸಹಿ ಮಾಡಿದ ಫಾರ್ಮ್‌ಗಳು ಅಥವಾ ಚೆಕ್‌ಗಳು.

red_flag.en: Someone collecting documents or cheques outside the bank.
red_flag.hi: कोई बैंक के बाहर कागज या चेक इकट्ठा कर रहा हो।
red_flag.ta: வங்கிக்கு வெளியே ஒருவர் ஆவணங்களையோ காசோலைகளையோ சேகரிக்கிறார்.
red_flag.te: బ్యాంకు బయట ఎవరో పత్రాలు లేదా చెక్కులు సేకరిస్తున్నారు.
red_flag.ml: ബാങ്കിന് പുറത്ത് ഒരാൾ രേഖകളോ ചെക്കുകളോ ശേഖരിക്കുന്നു.
red_flag.kn: ಬ್ಯಾಂಕ್‌ನ ಹೊರಗೆ ಯಾರೋ ದಾಖಲೆ ಅಥವಾ ಚೆಕ್ ಸಂಗ್ರಹಿಸುತ್ತಿದ್ದಾರೆ.

do.en: Give documents and cheques only at your bank branch or to its authorised staff. Strangers can take loans in your name with them.
do.hi: कागज और चेक सिर्फ अपनी बैंक ब्रांच में या उसके अधिकृत कर्मचारी को दें। अनजान लोग इनसे आपके नाम पर लोन ले सकते हैं।
do.ta: ஆவணங்களையும் காசோலைகளையும் உங்கள் வங்கிக் கிளையில் அல்லது அதன் அங்கீகரிக்கப்பட்ட ஊழியரிடம் மட்டும் கொடுங்கள். அவற்றை வைத்து தெரியாதவர்கள் உங்கள் பெயரில் கடன் வாங்கலாம்.
do.te: పత్రాలు, చెక్కులను మీ బ్యాంకు బ్రాంచ్‌లో లేదా దాని అధీకృత సిబ్బందికి మాత్రమే ఇవ్వండి. వాటితో అపరిచితులు మీ పేరుపై లోన్లు తీసుకోగలరు.
do.ml: രേഖകളും ചെക്കുകളും നിങ്ങളുടെ ബാങ്ക് ബ്രാഞ്ചിലോ അതിന്റെ അംഗീകൃത ജീവനക്കാർക്കോ മാത്രം നൽകൂ. അപരിചിതർക്ക് അവ ഉപയോഗിച്ച് നിങ്ങളുടെ പേരിൽ ലോൺ എടുക്കാനാകും.
do.kn: ದಾಖಲೆ ಮತ್ತು ಚೆಕ್‌ಗಳನ್ನು ನಿಮ್ಮ ಬ್ಯಾಂಕ್ ಶಾಖೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಅಥವಾ ಅದರ ಅಧಿಕೃತ ಸಿಬ್ಬಂದಿಗೆ ಮಾತ್ರ ಕೊಡಿ. ಅವುಗಳಿಂದ ಅಪರಿಚಿತರು ನಿಮ್ಮ ಹೆಸರಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಸಾಲ ಪಡೆಯಬಹುದು.

sources.name: RBI: BE(A)WARE booklet on frauds and precautions (2022)
RBI: Raju and the Forty Thieves, 40 frauds and precautions (2022)

name.en: Betting or gaming app with a “welcome bonus”
name.hi: “वेलकम बोनस” वाला सट्टा या गेमिंग ऐप
name.ta: “வெல்கம் போனஸ்” தரும் பந்தயம் அல்லது கேமிங் செயலி
name.te: “వెల్‌కమ్ బోనస్” ఇచ్చే బెట్టింగ్ లేదా గేమింగ్ యాప్
name.ml: “വെൽക്കം ബോണസ്” ഉള്ള ബെറ്റിങ് അല്ലെങ്കിൽ ഗെയിമിങ് ആപ്പ്
name.kn: “ವೆಲ್‌ಕಮ್ ಬೋನಸ್” ಇರುವ ಬೆಟ್ಟಿಂಗ್ ಅಥವಾ ಗೇಮಿಂಗ್ ಆ್ಯಪ್

they_say.en: Recharge ₹5,000 and get ₹5,000 bonus. Win big every day!
they_say.hi: ₹5,000 रिचार्ज करो और ₹5,000 बोनस पाओ। रोज बड़ा जीतो!
they_say.ta: ₹5,000 ரீசார்ஜ் செய்யுங்கள், ₹5,000 போனஸ் பெறுங்கள். தினமும் பெரிதாக வெல்லுங்கள்!
they_say.ml: ₹5,000 റീചാർജ് ചെയ്യൂ, ₹5,000 ബോണസ് നേടൂ. ദിവസവും വലിയ തുക നേടൂ!
they_say.kn: ₹5,000 ರೀಚಾರ್ಜ್ ಮಾಡಿ, ₹5,000 ಬೋನಸ್ ಪಡೆಯಿರಿ. ಪ್ರತಿದಿನ ದೊಡ್ಡದಾಗಿ ಗೆಲ್ಲಿರಿ!

they_ask.en: Money for recharges, then “fees” to withdraw.
they_ask.hi: रिचार्ज के पैसे, फिर पैसे निकालने के लिए “फीस”।
they_ask.ta: ரீசார்ஜுக்குப் பணம், பிறகு எடுக்க “கட்டணம்”.
they_ask.te: రీఛార్జ్‌లకు డబ్బు, తర్వాత తీయడానికి “ఫీజులు”.
they_ask.ml: റീചാർജിന് പണം, പിന്നെ പിൻവലിക്കാൻ “ഫീസുകൾ”.
they_ask.kn: ರೀಚಾರ್ಜ್‌ಗೆ ಹಣ, ನಂತರ ತೆಗೆಯಲು “ಶುಲ್ಕ”.

red_flag.en: Bonus money for a first deposit, and you can’t take your winnings out.
red_flag.hi: पहली जमा पर बोनस, और जीते हुए पैसे निकाल नहीं पाते।
red_flag.ta: முதல் டெபாசிட்டுக்கு போனஸ் பணம், வென்ற பணத்தை எடுக்க முடியாது.
red_flag.te: మొదటి డిపాజిట్‌కు బోనస్ డబ్బు, గెలిచిన డబ్బు తీయలేరు.
red_flag.ml: ആദ്യ ഡെപ്പോസിറ്റിന് ബോണസ് പണം, നേടിയ പണം പിൻവലിക്കാനാവില്ല.
red_flag.kn: ಮೊದಲ ಠೇವಣಿಗೆ ಬೋನಸ್ ಹಣ, ಗೆದ್ದ ಹಣ ತೆಗೆಯಲು ಆಗುವುದಿಲ್ಲ.

do.en: Don’t pay on unknown betting or gaming sites and apps. If you paid, call your bank to block your card or UPI, and report it at cybercrime.gov.in.
do.hi: अनजान सट्टा या गेमिंग साइटों और ऐप पर पैसे न दें। अगर दे दिए हैं, तो कार्ड या UPI ब्लॉक करवाने के लिए अपने बैंक को फोन करें, और cybercrime.gov.in पर शिकायत करें।
do.ta: தெரியாத பந்தய அல்லது கேமிங் தளங்களிலும் செயலிகளிலும் பணம் கட்டாதீர்கள். கட்டியிருந்தால், உங்கள் கார்டு அல்லது UPI-ஐ முடக்க வங்கியை அழைத்து, cybercrime.gov.in-இல் புகார் அளியுங்கள்.
do.te: తెలియని బెట్టింగ్ లేదా గేమింగ్ సైట్లు, యాప్‌లలో డబ్బు కట్టకండి. కట్టి ఉంటే, మీ కార్డు లేదా UPI బ్లాక్ చేయడానికి మీ బ్యాంకుకు కాల్ చేసి, cybercrime.gov.in లో ఫిర్యాదు చేయండి.
do.ml: അറിയാത്ത ബെറ്റിങ്, ഗെയിമിങ് സൈറ്റുകളിലും ആപ്പുകളിലും പണം അടയ്ക്കരുത്. അടച്ചുപോയെങ്കിൽ, കാർഡോ UPI-യോ ബ്ലോക്ക് ചെയ്യാൻ ബാങ്കിനെ വിളിച്ച്, cybercrime.gov.in-ൽ പരാതിപ്പെടൂ.
do.kn: ಗೊತ್ತಿಲ್ಲದ ಬೆಟ್ಟಿಂಗ್ ಅಥವಾ ಗೇಮಿಂಗ್ ಸೈಟ್ ಮತ್ತು ಆ್ಯಪ್‌ಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಹಣ ಕಟ್ಟಬೇಡಿ. ಕಟ್ಟಿದ್ದರೆ, ನಿಮ್ಮ ಕಾರ್ಡ್ ಅಥವಾ UPI ಬ್ಲಾಕ್ ಮಾಡಲು ಬ್ಯಾಂಕ್‌ಗೆ ಕರೆ ಮಾಡಿ, cybercrime.gov.in ನಲ್ಲಿ ದೂರು ನೀಡಿ.

sources.name: RBI: Raju and the Forty Thieves, 40 frauds and precautions (2022)

name.en: Fake loan recovery agent
name.hi: नकली लोन वसूली एजेंट
name.ta: போலி கடன் வசூல் ஏஜென்ட்
name.te: నకిలీ లోన్ రికవరీ ఏజెంట్
name.ml: വ്യാജ ലോൺ റിക്കവറി ഏജന്റ്
name.kn: ನಕಲಿ ಸಾಲ ವಸೂಲಾತಿ ಏಜೆಂಟ್

they_say.en: You have unpaid dues. Pay me now in cash or we will take action.
they_say.hi: आपका बकाया है। अभी नकद दो, वरना हम कार्रवाई करेंगे।
they_say.ta: உங்களுக்குச் செலுத்தாத நிலுவை உள்ளது. இப்போதே பணமாகக் கட்டுங்கள், இல்லையென்றால் நடவடிக்கை எடுப்போம்.
they_say.te: మీకు బకాయిలు ఉన్నాయి. ఇప్పుడే నగదు ఇవ్వండి, లేకపోతే చర్య తీసుకుంటాం.
they_say.ml: നിങ്ങൾക്ക് അടയ്ക്കാനുള്ള കുടിശ്ശികയുണ്ട്. ഇപ്പോൾത്തന്നെ പണമായി തരൂ, ഇല്ലെങ്കിൽ നടപടിയെടുക്കും.
they_say.kn: ನಿಮ್ಮದು ಬಾಕಿ ಇದೆ. ಈಗಲೇ ನಗದು ಕೊಡಿ, ಇಲ್ಲದಿದ್ದರೆ ಕ್ರಮ ಕೈಗೊಳ್ಳುತ್ತೇವೆ.

they_ask.en: Cash, or money to a personal account.
they_ask.hi: नकद, या किसी निजी खाते में पैसे।
they_ask.ta: ரொக்கம், அல்லது தனிநபர் கணக்குக்குப் பணம்.
they_ask.te: నగదు, లేదా వ్యక్తిగత ఖాతాకు డబ్బు.
they_ask.ml: പണമായി, അല്ലെങ്കിൽ വ്യക്തിഗത അക്കൗണ്ടിലേക്ക്.
they_ask.kn: ನಗದು, ಅಥವಾ ವೈಯಕ್ತಿಕ ಖಾತೆಗೆ ಹಣ.

red_flag.en: No recovery notice, no authorisation letter, and pressure to pay cash.
red_flag.hi: न वसूली नोटिस, न अधिकार पत्र, और नकद देने का दबाव।
red_flag.ta: வசூல் அறிவிப்பு இல்லை, அதிகாரக் கடிதம் இல்லை, ரொக்கமாகக் கட்ட வற்புறுத்தல்.
red_flag.te: రికవరీ నోటీసు లేదు, అధికార పత్రం లేదు, నగదు కట్టమని ఒత్తిడి.
red_flag.ml: റിക്കവറി നോട്ടീസില്ല, അനുമതിക്കത്തില്ല, പണമായി അടയ്ക്കാൻ സമ്മർദം.
red_flag.kn: ವಸೂಲಾತಿ ನೋಟಿಸ್ ಇಲ್ಲ, ಅಧಿಕಾರ ಪತ್ರ ಇಲ್ಲ, ನಗದು ಕೊಡಲು ಒತ್ತಡ.

do.en: Ask for the recovery notice, the bank’s authorisation letter and the agent’s ID card, and check with your branch before paying. Never pay cash without a proper receipt.
do.hi: वसूली नोटिस, बैंक का अधिकार पत्र और एजेंट का पहचान पत्र मांगें, और पैसे देने से पहले अपनी ब्रांच से पूछें। सही रसीद के बिना कभी नकद न दें।
do.ta: வசூல் அறிவிப்பு, வங்கியின் அதிகாரக் கடிதம், ஏஜென்டின் அடையாள அட்டை ஆகியவற்றைக் கேளுங்கள்; பணம் கட்டும் முன் உங்கள் கிளையில் உறுதிசெய்யுங்கள். முறையான ரசீது இல்லாமல் ரொக்கம் கொடுக்காதீர்கள்.
do.te: రికవరీ నోటీసు, బ్యాంకు అధికార పత్రం, ఏజెంట్ గుర్తింపు కార్డు అడగండి; కట్టే ముందు మీ బ్రాంచ్‌లో నిర్ధారించుకోండి. సరైన రసీదు లేకుండా ఎప్పుడూ నగదు ఇవ్వకండి.
do.ml: റിക്കവറി നോട്ടീസ്, ബാങ്കിന്റെ അനുമതിക്കത്ത്, ഏജന്റിന്റെ ID കാർഡ് എന്നിവ ചോദിക്കൂ; പണം നൽകും മുമ്പ് ബ്രാഞ്ചിൽ ഉറപ്പാക്കൂ. ശരിയായ രസീതില്ലാതെ ഒരിക്കലും പണം നൽകരുത്.
do.kn: ವಸೂಲಾತಿ ನೋಟಿಸ್, ಬ್ಯಾಂಕ್‌ನ ಅಧಿಕಾರ ಪತ್ರ ಮತ್ತು ಏಜೆಂಟ್‌ನ ಗುರುತಿನ ಚೀಟಿ ಕೇಳಿ; ಕಟ್ಟುವ ಮೊದಲು ನಿಮ್ಮ ಶಾಖೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಖಚಿತಪಡಿಸಿ. ಸರಿಯಾದ ರಸೀದಿ ಇಲ್ಲದೆ ಎಂದಿಗೂ ನಗದು ಕೊಡಬೇಡಿ.

sources.name: RBI: Raju and the Forty Thieves, 40 frauds and precautions (2022)

name.en: Banking on public Wi-Fi
name.hi: सार्वजनिक Wi-Fi पर बैंकिंग
name.ta: பொது Wi-Fi-இல் வங்கி வேலை
name.te: పబ్లిక్ Wi-Fiలో బ్యాంకింగ్
name.ml: പൊതു Wi-Fi-ൽ ബാങ്കിങ്
name.kn: ಸಾರ್ವಜನಿಕ Wi-Fiನಲ್ಲಿ ಬ್ಯಾಂಕಿಂಗ್

they_say.en: No message. Free Wi-Fi at a mall, station or café.
they_say.hi: कोई मैसेज नहीं। मॉल, स्टेशन या कैफे का मुफ्त Wi-Fi।
they_say.ta: எந்த மெசேஜும் இல்லை. மால், ரயில் நிலையம் அல்லது கஃபேயில் இலவச Wi-Fi.
they_say.te: ఏ మెసేజూ లేదు. మాల్, స్టేషన్ లేదా కేఫ్‌లో ఉచిత Wi-Fi.
they_say.ml: ഒരു സന്ദേശവുമില്ല. മാളിലോ സ്റ്റേഷനിലോ കഫേയിലോ സൗജന്യ Wi-Fi.
they_say.kn: ಯಾವ ಸಂದೇಶವೂ ಇಲ್ಲ. ಮಾಲ್, ನಿಲ್ದಾಣ ಅಥವಾ ಕೆಫೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಉಚಿತ Wi-Fi.

they_ask.en: Nothing. Someone on the same network can read what you type.
they_ask.hi: कुछ नहीं। उसी नेटवर्क पर कोई और आपका टाइप किया पढ़ सकता है।
they_ask.ta: எதுவும் இல்லை. அதே நெட்வொர்க்கில் உள்ள ஒருவர் நீங்கள் டைப் செய்வதைப் படிக்க முடியும்.
they_ask.te: ఏమీ లేదు. అదే నెట్‌వర్క్‌లో ఉన్నవారు మీరు టైప్ చేసేది చదవగలరు.
they_ask.ml: ഒന്നുമില്ല. അതേ നെറ്റ്‌വർക്കിലുള്ള ഒരാൾക്ക് നിങ്ങൾ ടൈപ്പ് ചെയ്യുന്നത് വായിക്കാനാകും.
they_ask.kn: ಏನೂ ಇಲ್ಲ. ಅದೇ ನೆಟ್‌ವರ್ಕ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿರುವ ಯಾರಾದರೂ ನೀವು ಟೈಪ್ ಮಾಡುವುದನ್ನು ಓದಬಹುದು.

red_flag.en: Paying or logging in to your bank on free public Wi-Fi.
red_flag.hi: मुफ्त सार्वजनिक Wi-Fi पर पेमेंट करना या बैंक में लॉग इन करना।
red_flag.ta: இலவச பொது Wi-Fi-இல் பணம் செலுத்துவது அல்லது வங்கியில் உள்நுழைவது.
red_flag.te: ఉచిత పబ్లిక్ Wi-Fiలో పేమెంట్ చేయడం లేదా బ్యాంకులో లాగిన్ అవ్వడం.
red_flag.ml: സൗജന്യ പൊതു Wi-Fi-ൽ പണമടയ്ക്കുകയോ ബാങ്കിൽ ലോഗിൻ ചെയ്യുകയോ ചെയ്യുന്നത്.
red_flag.kn: ಉಚಿತ ಸಾರ್ವಜನಿಕ Wi-Fiನಲ್ಲಿ ಪಾವತಿ ಮಾಡುವುದು ಅಥವಾ ಬ್ಯಾಂಕ್‌ಗೆ ಲಾಗಿನ್ ಆಗುವುದು.

do.en: Don’t use public Wi-Fi for banking or payments. Use your mobile data or a secured Wi-Fi network.
do.hi: बैंकिंग या पेमेंट के लिए सार्वजनिक Wi-Fi इस्तेमाल न करें। अपना मोबाइल डेटा या सुरक्षित Wi-Fi नेटवर्क इस्तेमाल करें।
do.ta: வங்கி வேலைக்கோ பணம் செலுத்தவோ பொது Wi-Fi-ஐப் பயன்படுத்தாதீர்கள். உங்கள் மொபைல் டேட்டா அல்லது பாதுகாப்பான Wi-Fi-ஐப் பயன்படுத்துங்கள்.
do.te: బ్యాంకింగ్‌కు, పేమెంట్లకు పబ్లిక్ Wi-Fi వాడకండి. మీ మొబైల్ డేటా లేదా సురక్షితమైన Wi-Fi నెట్‌వర్క్ వాడండి.
do.ml: ബാങ്കിങ്ങിനോ പണമടയ്ക്കാനോ പൊതു Wi-Fi ഉപയോഗിക്കരുത്. മൊബൈൽ ഡേറ്റയോ സുരക്ഷിതമായ Wi-Fi നെറ്റ്‌വർക്കോ ഉപയോഗിക്കൂ.
do.kn: ಬ್ಯಾಂಕಿಂಗ್ ಅಥವಾ ಪಾವತಿಗಳಿಗೆ ಸಾರ್ವಜನಿಕ Wi-Fi ಬಳಸಬೇಡಿ. ನಿಮ್ಮ ಮೊಬೈಲ್ ಡೇಟಾ ಅಥವಾ ಸುರಕ್ಷಿತ Wi-Fi ನೆಟ್‌ವರ್ಕ್ ಬಳಸಿ.

sources.name: RBI: Raju and the Forty Thieves, 40 frauds and precautions (2022)

name.en: Fake payment screen (for shopkeepers)
name.hi: नकली पेमेंट स्क्रीन (दुकानदारों के लिए)
name.ta: போலி பணம் செலுத்திய திரை (கடைக்காரர்களுக்கு)
name.te: నకిలీ పేమెంట్ స్క్రీన్ (దుకాణదారుల కోసం)
name.ml: വ്യാജ പേയ്‌മെന്റ് സ്ക്രീൻ (കടക്കാർക്ക്)
name.kn: ನಕಲಿ ಪಾವತಿ ಸ್ಕ್ರೀನ್ (ಅಂಗಡಿಯವರಿಗೆ)

they_say.en: Payment done, see my screen.
they_say.hi: पेमेंट हो गया, मेरी स्क्रीन देख लो।
they_say.ta: பணம் கட்டிவிட்டேன், என் திரையைப் பாருங்கள்.
they_say.te: పేమెంట్ అయిపోయింది, నా స్క్రీన్ చూడండి.
they_say.ml: പണം അയച്ചു, എന്റെ സ്ക്രീൻ നോക്കൂ.
they_say.kn: ಪಾವತಿ ಆಯಿತು, ನನ್ನ ಸ್ಕ್ರೀನ್ ನೋಡಿ.

they_ask.en: That you hand over the goods before the money reaches you.
they_ask.hi: पैसे आने से पहले सामान दे दें।
they_ask.ta: பணம் உங்களுக்கு வருவதற்கு முன்பே பொருளைக் கொடுங்கள்.
they_ask.te: డబ్బు మీకు చేరక ముందే సరుకు ఇవ్వమని.
they_ask.ml: പണം നിങ്ങൾക്ക് എത്തും മുമ്പ് സാധനം കൈമാറാൻ.
they_ask.kn: ಹಣ ನಿಮಗೆ ತಲುಪುವ ಮೊದಲೇ ವಸ್ತು ಕೊಡಿ ಎಂದು.

red_flag.en: A “paid” screen, but no money in your own account or app.
red_flag.hi: “पेमेंट हो गया” वाली स्क्रीन, पर आपके अपने खाते या ऐप में पैसे नहीं।
red_flag.ta: “கட்டப்பட்டது” என்று ஒரு திரை, ஆனால் உங்கள் சொந்தக் கணக்கிலோ செயலியிலோ பணம் இல்லை.
red_flag.te: “కట్టాం” అనే స్క్రీన్, కానీ మీ సొంత ఖాతాలో లేదా యాప్‌లో డబ్బు లేదు.
red_flag.ml: “അടച്ചു” എന്ന സ്ക്രീൻ, പക്ഷേ നിങ്ങളുടെ സ്വന്തം അക്കൗണ്ടിലോ ആപ്പിലോ പണമില്ല.
red_flag.kn: “ಪಾವತಿಸಲಾಗಿದೆ” ಎಂಬ ಸ್ಕ್ರೀನ್, ಆದರೆ ನಿಮ್ಮ ಸ್ವಂತ ಖಾತೆ ಅಥವಾ ಆ್ಯಪ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿ ಹಣ ಇಲ್ಲ.

do.en: Hand over goods only after the money shows in your own bank account or app.
do.hi: सामान तभी दें जब पैसे आपके अपने बैंक खाते या ऐप में दिख जाएं।
do.ta: உங்கள் சொந்த வங்கிக் கணக்கிலோ செயலியிலோ பணம் தெரிந்த பிறகே பொருளைக் கொடுங்கள்.
do.te: మీ సొంత బ్యాంకు ఖాతాలో లేదా యాప్‌లో డబ్బు కనిపించిన తర్వాతే సరుకు ఇవ్వండి.
do.ml: നിങ്ങളുടെ സ്വന്തം ബാങ്ക് അക്കൗണ്ടിലോ ആപ്പിലോ പണം കണ്ടതിന് ശേഷം മാത്രം സാധനം കൈമാറൂ.
do.kn: ನಿಮ್ಮ ಸ್ವಂತ ಬ್ಯಾಂಕ್ ಖಾತೆ ಅಥವಾ ಆ್ಯಪ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿ ಹಣ ಕಂಡ ನಂತರವೇ ವಸ್ತು ಕೊಡಿ.

sources.name: RBI: Raju and the Forty Thieves, 40 frauds and precautions (2022)

practice.label: scam
practice.text: Dear customer, Rs 48,500 has been debited from your account XX4521 to UPI ID rk.traders@ybl. If this transaction was not done by you, reply NO to block it.
practice.clue: Banks never ask you to reply YES or NO on WhatsApp. Don't reply: open your bank's own app and check.

source.name: Free Press Journal (Hyderabad Police, Oct 2026)

practice.label: real
practice.text: Dear UPI user A/C X4521 debited by 48500.00 on date 20Oct26 trf to RK TRADERS Refno 429187365512. If not u? call 1800111109. -SBI
practice.clue: Real. It comes by SMS from the bank's sender name, and tells you to call the bank's helpline, not to reply.

practice.label: scam
practice.text: Rs 5,000.00 credited to your A/c XX4521 by UPI from SURESH K. Avl Bal Rs 12,340.50
practice.context: A minute later a stranger calls: “I sent you 5,000 by mistake. Please send it back.”
practice.clue: A bank alert never comes from a mobile number. Check your balance in your bank's app before sending anything back: usually no money ever arrived.

source.name: Free Press Journal (Indore, Rs 70,000 lost)

practice.label: real
practice.text: Update! INR 5,000.00 credited to HDFC Bank A/c XX4521 on 20-10-26 by VPA suresh.k@okicici (UPI Ref No 429187365512).
practice.clue: Real. A credit alert from the bank's sender name. Even so, if someone calls saying they sent money by mistake, check your bank app first.

practice.label: scam
practice.text: Traffic challan: your vehicle MH12AB1234 has a pending fine of Rs 500 for over-speeding. Pay before 22-10-26 to avoid court: https://echallan.pasvahan.icu
practice.clue: Read the link slowly: “pasvahan”, not “parivahan”, and it doesn't end in .gov.in. Real challans are on echallan.parivahan.gov.in.

source.name: The Tribune (fake e-challan messages)

practice.label: real
practice.text: A challan of Rs 500 has been issued to vehicle MH12AB1234 for over-speeding. Details and payment: https://echallan.parivahan.gov.in
practice.clue: Real. A government sender name, and the link ends in .gov.in. Safest of all: type echallan.parivahan.gov.in yourself.

practice.label: scam
practice.text: Congratulations! You are selected for Dak Seva Gifts. Answer 4 short questions to win up to Rs 10,000: https://indiapost-dakseva.top
practice.clue: India Post runs no gift or lucky-draw scheme and doesn't message you on WhatsApp. Anyone can call themselves “India Post” in a profile name.

source.name: News On AIR (PIB Fact Check, Sept 2026)

practice.label: real
practice.text: Article EZ123456789IN booked to you is out for delivery today. Track it at https://www.indiapost.gov.in
practice.clue: Real. A delivery update from India Post's sender name, pointing to indiapost.gov.in, and it asks for nothing.

practice.label: scam
practice.text: “Hello, this is SBI's fraud department. A payment of Rs 75,000 is pending on your card. I'm sending an OTP to cancel it, please read it out.”
practice.clue: Banks are now required to call from numbers starting 1600. “The bank” calling from an ordinary mobile number is a red flag, and no bank ever asks for an OTP.

source.name: IANS (TRAI orders 1600-series for banks)

practice.label: real
practice.text: “Good afternoon, this is a courtesy call from your bank about your new card. Your card is active. You don't need to share any details.”
practice.clue: Real. Banks call from 1600-series numbers, and a genuine call never asks you for an OTP, PIN or card number.

practice.label: scam
practice.text: Mausi, it's Rahul. My phone fell in the water, this is my friend's number. Please send 15,000 urgently for the hostel fee, I'll return it tomorrow. Don't tell mummy please.
practice.clue: Call him back on the number you have saved. Scammers copy profile photos, and AI can even copy a voice.

source.name: Scroll (AI voice-clone family scams)

practice.label: real
practice.text: Dear Customer, periodic KYC update for your A/c XX4521 is due. Please visit your home branch or update it in the YONO SBI app. Ignore if already done. -SBI
practice.clue: Real. Banks do send KYC reminders, but from their sender name, with no link, sending you to the branch or their own app.

practice.label: scam
practice.text:
📄 SBI_KYC_Form.pdf
Dear customer, your KYC is pending. Fill this form today to avoid account freeze.
practice.clue: Banks never send KYC forms on WhatsApp. A bank logo as the profile photo proves nothing: anyone can upload one.

source.name: Moneylife (WhatsApp KYC message fraud)

practice.label: real
practice.text: Rs.25000 debited from HDFC Bank A/c XX4521 on 20-10-26 to VPA rk.traders@ybl. Not you? Call 18002586161 or SMS BLOCK UPI to 7308080808
practice.clue: Real, and the hardest one. It's from the bank's sender name, and SMS BLOCK goes to the bank's published number. Replying to a stranger on WhatsApp is different.

practice.label: scam
practice.senderNote: Video call. A police station is behind him.
practice.text: “Good afternoon, madam. I am Inspector Rakesh Sharma, Mumbai Cyber Cell. A SIM card in your Aadhaar name was used in a money-laundering case. Please stay on this video call while we record your statement. The matter is confidential, so do not discuss it with your family.”
practice.clue: There is no “digital arrest” in Indian law. Police never question or arrest anyone on a video call, never ask you to keep it secret, and never ask for money. Hang up and call 1930.

source.name: CERT-In: Cyber Security Handbook (2025)

practice.label: scam
practice.text: “This is an automated message from the Telecom Department. Your mobile number will be suspended within 2 hours because of illegal activity reported against your Aadhaar. Press 9 to speak to our officer.”
practice.clue: DoT and TRAI never call to disconnect a number. A recorded voice telling you to “press 9” puts you through to a scammer. Hang up and report it on Chakshu at sancharsaathi.gov.in.

source.name: PIB / DoT: fake calls threatening to disconnect your mobile

practice.label: scam
practice.text: “Hello, I'm calling from FedEx International. A parcel booked with your Aadhaar from Mumbai to Taiwan has been held by customs. It contains 5 passports and 140 grams of drugs. I'm connecting you to the Mumbai Narcotics officer to record your statement.”
practice.clue: Courier companies don't put you through to the police, and no agency settles a case by phone. The name on the screen can be faked. Hang up and call 1930.

source.name: PIB / I4C (MHA): alert on 'digital arrest' and blackmail calls; report on 1930

practice.label: scam
practice.text: Dear SBI customer, as per RBI guidelines your KYC must be re-verified by 25-10-2026 to continue YONO services. It takes 2 minutes: https://sbi-rekyc.in/verify . Ignore if already done.
practice.clue: “Ignore if already done” makes it sound calm, but it comes from a mobile number and the link isn't the bank's own site. Banks send KYC reminders with no link, from their sender name.

source.name: RBI: BE(A)WARE booklet on frauds and precautions (2022)

practice.label: scam
practice.text: Dear Consumer, your electricity connection will be disconnected tonight at 9:30 PM as your previous month bill was not updated. Please contact our electricity officer immediately on 87981 20445. Thank you.
practice.clue: Electricity companies don't send same-night cut-off warnings from mobile numbers. The “officer” will ask you to install an app. Check your bill only on the company's own app or website.

source.name: RBI: BE(A)WARE booklet on frauds and precautions (2022)

practice.label: scam
practice.text: HDFC Bank: 7,450 reward points on your credit card (worth Rs 7,450) expire tonight. Redeem them to your account in one step: https://hdfc-rewardz.co/redeem
practice.clue: Points that “expire tonight”, a link that isn't the bank's site, and a mobile number as the sender. Check your points only in your bank's own app.

source.name: RBI: BE(A)WARE booklet on frauds and precautions (2022)

practice.label: scam
practice.senderNote: You found this number in a Google search for a refund helpline.
practice.text: “Thank you for calling, ma'am. I'll process your refund right now. Please install the ‘Quick Support’ app from Play Store so I can guide you, and tell me the 9-digit code it shows.”
practice.clue: Real support never asks you to install a screen-sharing app or read out a code. Search results can show fake helplines: take the number only from the company's own app or website.

source.name: RBI: BE(A)WARE booklet on frauds and precautions (2022)

practice.label: scam
practice.senderNote: Added you to the group “Goldman Wealth Club 87”
practice.text: Good morning! Yesterday our SEBI-registered research team's 3 picks gained 11%. Members trade through our institutional app for IPO allocation and steady 30% monthly returns. Reply YES to get the app link.
practice.clue: Nobody can promise steady returns, and a “SEBI-registered” claim in a WhatsApp group means nothing. These apps let you see profits but make you pay a “tax” to withdraw.

source.name: SEBI: beware of fake trading app scams

practice.label: scam
practice.text: Hi, I'm Priya from Zenith Digital. We have part-time work: like YouTube videos and earn Rs 50 per like, Rs 1,500 to 4,000 a day, paid daily to your UPI. It takes only 15 minutes. Shall I share the details?
practice.clue: They pay small amounts at first, then ask you to pay for “prepaid tasks” to earn more. A real job never asks you to pay.

source.name: RBI: BE(A)WARE booklet on frauds and precautions (2022)

practice.label: scam
practice.senderNote: The voice sounds exactly like your son.
practice.text: “Papa, it's me. I've had an accident and my phone broke. The police here will let me go if we pay 50,000 now. Please send it to this officer's number, I'll explain later. Don't tell Mummy, she'll panic.”
practice.clue: AI can copy a voice from a few seconds of audio. Hurry plus “don't tell anyone” is the sign. Hang up and call your son on the number you already have.

source.name: RBI: BE(A)WARE booklet on frauds and precautions (2022)

practice.label: scam
practice.text: Your personal loan of Rs 2,00,000 at 9% interest is approved by Bajaj Finserv. Only Rs 1,999 file charges are payable before disbursal. Pay to finserv.loans@ybl and share the screenshot on this number.
practice.clue: Real lenders take any charges out of the loan amount. Paying a fee to a UPI ID before you get the money is the scam.

source.name: RBI: BE(A)WARE booklet on frauds and precautions (2022)

practice.label: scam
practice.text: IndiaPost: Your package has arrived at the warehouse but could not be delivered due to incomplete address information. Please update your address within 48 hours: https://indiapost.gov.in-track.top/IN
practice.clue: Read the link to the end: it starts with “indiapost.gov.in” but the site is “in-track.top”. India Post never sends links to update your address.

source.name: RBI: BE(A)WARE booklet on frauds and precautions (2022)

practice.label: scam
practice.text: Income Tax Dept: You are eligible for a refund of Rs 15,490.00 for AY 2026-27. Your bank account number appears incorrect. Please verify it at https://incometax-refund.org.in to receive it within 24 hours.
practice.clue: Refunds go straight to the bank account in your tax return, and the department never sends refund links. The only site is incometax.gov.in.

source.name: PIB / Income Tax Department: phishing advisory

practice.label: scam
practice.text: Pre-approved instant loan of Rs 3,00,000 for you. No documents, no CIBIL check, money in 10 minutes. Download Rupee Fast: https://bit.ly/rupeefast-loan
practice.clue: Loan apps sent by SMS often read your contacts and later threaten to shame you. Borrow only from banks and lenders listed with RBI.

source.name: RBI: BE(A)WARE booklet on frauds and precautions (2022)

practice.label: scam
practice.text: Dear Madam, a parcel from Mr. Daniel Brown (UK) is held at Delhi customs. It contains gold jewellery, an iPhone and GBP 25,000 cash. Clearance charges of Rs 38,500 must be paid today, or it will be sent back.
practice.clue: The “friend” from social media and the “cargo company” are the same gang. Customs never asks you to pay a personal account or UPI ID. Don't pay any fee to receive a gift.

source.name: RBI: BE(A)WARE booklet on frauds and precautions (2022)

practice.label: scam
practice.text: Hi dear, sorry to disturb. I sent a 6-digit code to your number by mistake while logging in. Can you please forward it to me? It's a bit urgent.
practice.clue: That code is the key to your own WhatsApp, and Meena Aunty's account has probably been taken over. Never share a code you receive, even with people you know. Call her instead.

source.name: RBI: BE(A)WARE booklet on frauds and precautions (2022)

practice.label: scam
practice.senderNote: Seller of a scooter on OLX
practice.text: Sir, I am in the Army, transferred to Pune, so I'm selling my Activa (2022) for only 28,000. It will come by Army cargo. Pay 4,500 cargo charges first, the rest on delivery.
practice.clue: Army officers don't sell vehicles through OLX with “cargo charges”. Never pay before you've seen the vehicle and its papers.

source.name: RBI: BE(A)WARE booklet on frauds and precautions (2022)

practice.label: scam
practice.text: Done ma'am, I'm paying the full 12,000. I've sent you a QR code for the payment. Just scan it in Google Pay and enter your UPI PIN to receive the money.
practice.clue: You never need to scan a QR code or enter your PIN to receive money. Your PIN is only for paying: entering it sends money out.

source.name: RBI: BE(A)WARE booklet on frauds and precautions (2022)

practice.label: scam
practice.text: This is Inspector Vikram Rathore, Cyber Crime Branch. A complaint about your obscene video call has been filed. To close the case without an FIR and remove the video from YouTube, pay the settlement of Rs 51,000 today.
practice.clue: The “inspector” is the same blackmailer. Police never settle cases for money on WhatsApp. Don't pay, keep screenshots and report at cybercrime.gov.in or 1930. You are the victim, not the guilty one.

source.name: CERT-In: Cyber Security Handbook (2025)

practice.label: scam
practice.senderNote: Says he's from Jio customer care.
practice.text: “Sir, your SIM is eligible for a free eSIM upgrade for better 5G speed. You'll get an SMS with a code now. Please read it to me so I can activate it, it only takes 5 minutes.”
practice.clue: That code moves your number to the scammer's phone, and then your bank OTPs go to them. Your operator never needs a code from you on a call.

source.name: RBI: BE(A)WARE booklet on frauds and precautions (2022)

practice.label: scam
practice.text: “I'm calling from IRDAI, the insurance regulator. Your old LIC policy has a pending bonus of Rs 4,62,000. To release it, you only need to pay the GST of Rs 18,400 first, which will be refunded with the bonus.”
practice.clue: IRDAI never calls people or announces bonuses, and no insurer asks for a fee to pay you. Check with your insurer on the number in your policy papers.

source.name: IRDAI public notice: spurious calls and fake offers

practice.label: scam
practice.senderNote: From a “Kedarnath Heli Booking” page on Facebook
practice.text: Namaste ji. Phata to Kedarnath helicopter, 2 seats are available on 28 Oct. Fare Rs 6,980 per person. Send Rs 13,960 to kedarheli.irctc@okaxis and the tickets will be emailed within 1 hour.
practice.clue: Kedarnath helicopter tickets are sold only on heliyatra.irctc.co.in. A UPI ID with “irctc” in it is just a name anyone can choose.

source.name: PIB (I4C alert on fake booking sites)

practice.label: scam
practice.text: Diwali clearance: Nike Air Jordan at Rs 1,499 (MRP 14,999). Only 6 pairs left in your size! Prepaid orders only, pay by UPI and we ship today.
practice.clue: 90% off branded goods, prepaid only and no cash on delivery: nothing arrives, or a cheap fake does. Buy only from known apps and sites.

source.name: RBI: BE(A)WARE booklet on frauds and precautions (2022)

practice.label: scam
practice.text: Work from home: just receive payments from our clients in your bank account and transfer them to our company account. Earn 3% commission on every transaction, Rs 2,000 to 5,000 a day. Interested?
practice.clue: That money is stolen from scam victims. Your account gets frozen and you can be arrested, even for a small commission. Never let anyone use your account.

source.name: RBI: BE(A)WARE booklet on frauds and precautions (2022)

practice.label: scam
practice.text: Greetings from Bangkok! Customer support job (English typing), salary Rs 1,10,000 a month plus free flight, hotel and food. Just a simple typing test. Visa on arrival, we arrange everything. Join by 5 Nov.
practice.clue: Real overseas jobs come with a signed contract and a work visa through registered agents, never a tourist visa. People taken this way are forced to work in scam centres.

source.name: All India Radio (MEA advisory)

practice.label: scam
practice.text: Kerala floods: help families who lost everything. Donate to the CM Relief Fund through UPI cmdrf.kerala@sbi or scan the QR. Every rupee counts.
practice.clue: Lookalike UPI IDs in forwards collect “donations” for scammers. Donate only through the fund's official website.

source.name: Business Standard (Delhi Police, 2020)

practice.label: scam
practice.text: A man in a uniform says: “Aadhaar biometric update camp. Just put your thumb on this machine to update your records, it's free.” He has no ID card and no letter.
practice.clue: Copied fingerprints are used to withdraw money through Aadhaar at cash points. Lock your biometrics on uidai.gov.in and give your fingerprint only at an official centre.

source.name: PIB / UIDAI: lock your biometrics at uidai.gov.in

practice.label: scam
practice.text: The card slot looks a little bulky and loose. A friendly man behind you says: “It's always like that, push hard. Let me help you.”
practice.clue: A loose or bulky slot can hide a card copier, and a “helper” can watch your PIN. Use another ATM, and cover the keypad when you type your PIN.

source.name: RBI: BE(A)WARE booklet on frauds and precautions (2022)

practice.label: scam
practice.text: Your phone is at 5%. There's a free charging kiosk with USB cables already attached, and a sign saying “Free mobile charging”.
practice.clue: A USB cable or port you don't own can copy data or install harmful software. Carry your own charger and plug it into a normal power socket.

source.name: RBI: BE(A)WARE booklet on frauds and precautions (2022)

practice.label: scam
practice.text: Deposit Rs 10,000 today and get Rs 20,000 back in 30 days. Add 3 members and earn Rs 1,000 for each. Sunita ji from your area got Rs 40,000 last month, ask her!
practice.clue: Money that doubles fast and pays you for adding members is a chain scheme. The first people are paid with newer members' money, then it collapses.

source.name: RBI: BE(A)WARE booklet on frauds and precautions (2022)

practice.label: scam
practice.text: “Hello aunty, I got your number from Neha, I'm organising the society puja. Another committee member is calling you right now, please merge the call so we can all talk together.”
practice.clue: The “other caller” is your bank's OTP call, and merging lets the scammer hear the code. Nobody genuine needs you to merge calls.

source.name: CERT-In: Cyber Security Handbook (2025)

practice.label: scam
practice.text: Census 2027: Dear citizen, house listing for your family is pending. Verify your household details to avoid a penalty: https://censusindia-verify.in
practice.clue: Official census messages come only from senders with “RGICEN” in the name, and there is no penalty to pay. Census staff carry ID with a QR code.

source.name: PIB: Census 2027, official messages carry 'RGICEN'

practice.label: scam
practice.text: Dear customer, your gas connection will be disconnected today at 9:30 PM because your KYC is not updated. Please contact our officer immediately on this number.
practice.clue: Anyone can name their WhatsApp “Indane Gas Service”. Gas KYC is done free with your distributor, and gas companies never threaten same-day cut-offs.

source.name: HP Gas (HPCL): FAQ on KYC

practice.label: scam
practice.text: EPFO: Your PF withdrawal of Rs 1,84,300 is on hold because your KYC is incomplete. Update UAN and bank details at https://epfo-claim.online to receive it in 3 days.
practice.clue: EPFO's only website is epfindia.gov.in, and it never asks for KYC by SMS. Use the official site or the UMANG app, free of cost.

source.name: PIB / EPFO: use official EPFO portals, free of cost

practice.label: scam
practice.senderNote: Replied to your enquiry on a rental website
practice.text: Hello, the 2BHK in Koramangala is still available at Rs 14,000 rent. I'm posted in Dubai so I can't show it myself. Pay Rs 10,000 token and I'll courier the keys today. Many people are asking.
practice.clue: An owner who can't meet, can't show the flat and rushes you to pay. Never pay a token for a place you haven't seen.

source.name: RBI: Raju and the Forty Thieves, 40 frauds and precautions (2022)

practice.label: scam
practice.text: Dear Pensioner, your pension will be stopped from next month as your life certificate is not submitted. Submit it online in 5 minutes for Rs 199 at https://jeevanpraman.online
practice.clue: The only official site is jeevanpramaan.gov.in, and it's free. You can also give your life certificate at the bank or post office, or the postman can do it at home.

source.name: PIB / India Post: Jeevan Pramaan life certificate at the post office or doorstep

practice.label: scam
practice.text: An envelope from “Meesho Lucky Draw” has a scratch card inside. You scratch it: “1st prize: Tata Nexon or Rs 14,80,000”. The helpline says to pay Rs 8,500 registration and GST to claim it.
practice.clue: Shopping sites don't run lucky draws by post, and you never pay to receive a real prize. The fees never stop.

source.name: RBI: BE(A)WARE booklet on frauds and precautions (2022)

practice.label: scam
practice.text: “Uncle, this is Officer Brian from Toronto police. Your nephew Aman was in a fight and will be deported tonight unless the fine of 2,500 dollars is paid. He's crying, I'll put him on. Please don't tell his parents yet.”
practice.clue: Urgency, secrecy and a voice you can't quite check. Before you pay, call your nephew or his parents on a number you already have.

source.name: RBI: BE(A)WARE booklet on frauds and precautions (2022)

practice.label: scam
practice.senderNote: Says he's from your bank's support team.
practice.text: “Ma'am, to fix the problem with your net banking I'll guide you on screen. Please install AnyDesk from Play Store and read me the 9-digit number it shows.”
practice.clue: With that number he can see and control your phone, including your bank app. Never install a screen-sharing app because a caller asks.

source.name: RBI: BE(A)WARE booklet on frauds and precautions (2022)

practice.label: scam
practice.text: “Congratulations sir, your SBI card's annual fee of Rs 4,999 can be waived for life today. I've sent a verification code to your mobile, please read it out to confirm.”
practice.clue: That “verification code” approves a payment from your card. Banks never ask for an OTP or card details on a call. Hang up and call the number on the back of your card.

source.name: RBI: Raju and the Forty Thieves, 40 frauds and precautions (2022)

practice.label: scam
practice.senderNote: Says he's from your bank's loan department.
practice.text: “Madam, your pre-approved FD overdraft is ready. I'll come home tomorrow to collect copies of your Aadhaar and PAN and one signed blank cheque, so you don't have to visit the branch.”
practice.clue: With your ID copies and a signed cheque, strangers can take loans in your name. Give documents only at your branch.

source.name: RBI: BE(A)WARE booklet on frauds and precautions (2022)

practice.label: scam
practice.text: Welcome bonus! Recharge Rs 5,000 and get Rs 5,000 FREE. Play Teen Patti and Aviator, win up to Rs 50,000 daily, instant withdrawal: https://win777.club
practice.clue: A bonus for your first deposit, and then your winnings can't be taken out without more “fees”. Don't pay on unknown betting apps.

source.name: RBI: Raju and the Forty Thieves, 40 frauds and precautions (2022)

practice.label: scam
practice.text: “I'm calling from the recovery department of your bank. You have Rs 38,000 overdue on your loan. Pay me today in cash or to this UPI, otherwise our team will come to your house and tell your neighbours.”
practice.clue: Ask for the recovery notice, the bank's authorisation letter and the agent's ID, and check with your branch. Never pay cash or a personal UPI ID.

source.name: RBI: Raju and the Forty Thieves, 40 frauds and precautions (2022)

practice.label: scam
practice.text: A free Wi-Fi called “Airport_Free_WiFi” needs no password. You need to pay your electricity bill urgently through your bank app.
practice.clue: On free public Wi-Fi, someone on the same network can see what you type. Use your mobile data for banking and payments.

source.name: RBI: Raju and the Forty Thieves, 40 frauds and precautions (2022)

practice.label: scam
practice.text: The buyer shows you his phone: a Google Pay screen saying “₹12,000 paid successfully”, and starts loading the fridge into his tempo.
practice.clue: A screen can be faked. Hand over the goods only after the money shows in your own bank account or app.

source.name: RBI: Raju and the Forty Thieves, 40 frauds and precautions (2022)

practice.label: real
practice.text: OTP for txn of INR 2,350.00 at AMAZON on HDFC Bank card XX8812 is 482910. Valid for 10 mins. Do not share this OTP with anyone. -HDFC Bank
practice.clue: Real. It's from the bank's sender name, and it's an OTP for a payment you made yourself. The only rule: never read it out to anyone.

practice.label: real
practice.text: Your Indane refill booking no. 1187465 for consumer no. 734512 is confirmed. Cash memo amount Rs 853.50. Delivery in 2-3 days.
practice.clue: Real. A booking confirmation from Indane's sender name. It asks for nothing.

practice.label: real
practice.text: Dear Consumer, your electricity bill for Oct-26 of Rs 1,240 is generated. Due date 05-11-26. Pay on the MSEDCL app or www.mahadiscom.in. Ignore if paid.
practice.clue: Real. A normal bill from the company's sender name, with a due date weeks away and its own website. No threat, no “officer” to call.

practice.label: real
practice.text: Dear member, Rs 12,600 has been credited to your PF account for Sep-26 by your employer. Check your passbook on the UMANG app or epfindia.gov.in.
practice.clue: Real. From EPFO's sender name, pointing to its own website and app, asking for nothing.

practice.label: real
practice.text: Refund of Rs 15,490 for AY 2026-27 has been credited to your bank account XX4521. -Income Tax Department
practice.clue: Real. A real refund just arrives in your account: no link, nothing to verify.

practice.label: real
practice.text: We have received your eSIM request. If you did NOT ask for this, call 121 immediately. Never share the eSIM QR code or OTP with anyone.
practice.clue: Real. Your operator warns you about a request and tells you to call its own helpline. It doesn't ask for any code.

practice.label: real
practice.text: “Hello, this is HDFC Bank. We noticed a payment of Rs 49,000 on your card at an online store. If you made it, no action is needed. If not, please block the card in the HDFC app or call the number on the back of your card. We will never ask for your OTP.”
practice.clue: Real. Banks call from numbers starting 1600, and a real call sends you to the bank's own app or helpline. It never asks for an OTP.

practice.label: real
practice.text: Your order from Meghana Foods is on its way! Arriving in 18 mins. Track it: swiggy.com/track
practice.clue: Real. A verified business with a green tick, about an order you placed, linking to its own website.

practice.label: real
practice.text: Ma, I reached Bengaluru safely. Will call you after the meeting, around 7.
practice.clue: Real. A saved contact, a normal update, and nothing asked of you.

practice.label: real
practice.text: Your pension for Oct 2026 of Rs 32,450 has been credited to A/c XX9031. -SBI
practice.clue: Real. A credit alert from the bank's sender name. Even so, you can check it in your passbook or bank app.

practice.label: real
practice.text: Census 2027: House listing in your area runs from 1 to 30 Nov. Enumerators carry an ID card with a QR code. No OTP or payment is ever needed.
practice.clue: Real. Official census messages come from senders with “RGICEN” in the name, and they tell you what officials will never ask for.

practice.label: real
practice.text: Dear customer, eKYC for your HP Gas connection can be done free at your distributor or in the HP Pay app. Ignore if done.
practice.clue: Real. From HP Gas's sender name, free, at your distributor or in the company's own app, with no deadline threat.

practice.label: real
practice.text: Digital Life Certificate submitted successfully. Pramaan ID 3F7A2X91. -Jeevan Pramaan
practice.clue: Real. A confirmation after you gave your life certificate, from the official sender name. It asks for nothing.

practice.label: real
practice.text: Your Blue Dart shipment 75421690311 is out for delivery today. Track it at bluedart.com
practice.clue: Real. A delivery update from the courier's sender name, pointing to its own website, asking for nothing.

practice.label: real
practice.text: Rs 135.00 deducted from your FASTag for MH12AB1234 at Khed Shivapur plaza. Avl bal Rs 865.00. -ICICI Bank
practice.clue: Real. A toll deduction from the bank's sender name, for a trip you made.

practice.label: real
practice.text: 384920 is your Amazon OTP. Do not share it with anyone.
practice.clue: Real, if you just logged in or paid on Amazon yourself. If you didn't, someone is trying to use your account: still never share it.

practice.label: real
practice.senderNote: A mobile number you don't know
practice.text: “Hello madam, I'm the Amazon delivery person, I'm at your building gate. Should I bring the parcel up to the 3rd floor?”
practice.clue: Real. Not every unknown caller is a scammer: he asks for nothing but directions. It would turn into a scam only if he asked for an OTP or money.

practice.label: real
practice.text: Mausi, sending the photos from Diwali. Can you send me the rasmalai recipe when you're free?
practice.clue: Real. A saved contact chatting, with nothing urgent and no money asked.

practice.label: real
practice.text: You have received Rs 2,000 from RAJESH KUMAR in your Paytm UPI. UPI Ref 614523987711.
practice.clue: Real. Money received needs no PIN and no QR scan. The alert comes from the bank's sender name.

practice.label: real
practice.text: Premium of Rs 18,260 for policy 912345678 is due on 28-10-26. Pay at licindia.in or the LIC app. Ignore if paid.
practice.clue: Real. A premium reminder from LIC's sender name, sending you to its own website and app.

practice.label: real
practice.text: Check how many mobile connections are issued in your name on sancharsaathi.gov.in. DoT never calls to disconnect numbers.
practice.clue: Real. A government sender name, a .gov.in website, and it tells you what DoT will never do.
